title: Late delivery and tracking policy
content: Check carrier tracking, the promised date, and delivery exceptions. Offer a replacement or refund only when the late-delivery policy permits it.

title: Missing parcel investigation
content: Confirm the address and tracking history, then open a carrier investigation when a parcel is marked delivered but is missing.

title: Returns and refund eligibility
content: Verify the return window, item condition and original payment method before approving a refund or escalation.

title: Damaged item replacement procedure
content: Apologise, record the item and damage type, request minimum necessary evidence, then arrange replacement or refund under policy.

title: Payment failure and duplicate charge guide
content: Check payment authorisation and order status. Never ask customers to send full card numbers or bank credentials.

title: Account access and password reset
content: Use the approved verification flow before account changes. Send a password-reset link and escalate locked accounts when necessary.

title: Cancelling or changing an order
content: Check fulfilment status before cancellation or address changes. Changes are not available after dispatch.
